entities.name: Bruno Mauricio de Zabala
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bruno Mauricio de Zabala y Gortázar was a Spanish soldier and colonial administrator who served as governor of the Governorate of the Río de la Plata from 1717 to 1734 and founded the city of Montevideo, capital of present-day Uruguay.
